message.content:
{
  "findings": [
    {
      "ref": "[R452]",
      "area": "content",
      "claim": "A parent reports seeing an option to sacrifice children, which they describe as super twisted and demonic.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "I found out that this game gives the option to sacrifice your children. That is super twisted and demonic. Do better Stardew valley! You don’t need to let people down like that."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R462]",
      "area": "contact",
      "claim": "A parent reports that the iOS version lacks proper controller support, making button mapping confusing and allowing accidental item tossing without warning.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "The game is great, but controls are not so great. It feels super weird to try and use the screen as a controller, so I picked up a tiny Bluetooth controller to try out with the iOS version of the game. Turns out there’s no “good” way to map the buttons that makes sense. For whatever reason, when I map my interaction buttons out, depending on how I map it, one button is always capable of tossing items out from the inventory menu— and there’s no warning for it."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R486]",
      "area": "money",
      "claim": "A parent reports that the game’s time speeding mechanic creates unnecessary stress, making it feel like a deal breaker for farming games.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "I'm on my second replay. I played for many hours and I have to say this game is extremely stressful unnecessarily because of the time speeding by. This is a -100 as far as I'm concerned. Wylde Flowers is the better game. Players should be able to slow time and enjoy. This has been a deal breaker for so many farming games. Players need to be in charge of time and seasons. Period. Horrible horrible game and music that will drive you nuts."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R493]",
      "area": "money",
      "claim": "A parent reports that fishing on iOS is too hard because tapping or holding does not work, causing the fishing pole to pull back up and the module never appears.",
      "stance": "mitigation",
      "quote": "I love the game a lot, all my levels are high except fishing which is too hard in iOS app. When I tap or even try to hold down on the screen the fishing pole just pulls back up, and the fishing module never pops up. Hope it gets an update."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R468]",
      "area": "bug",
      "claim": "A parent reports a bug where repeating SL causes physical strength and sleep time to carry over to the next day, disrupting progress.",
      "stance": "mitigation",
      "quote": "Feedback a bug. When you repeat SL, the physical strength and time of the next day of sleep will stay at the previous day."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R490]",
      "area": "money",
      "claim": "A parent suggests adding stocks or real estate and cryptocurrency as new monetization features.",
      "stance": "neutral",
      "quote": "The game is great but I think if it had stocks or real estate and cryptocurrency"
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R487]",
      "area": "content",
      "claim": "A parent suggests adding more people and jobs to the game to increase variety and engagement.",
      "stance": "neutral",
      "quote": "I love this game. I just have 3 problems with it. You can get bored easily. I think you should add a choice to get a job at a store. My other problem is there is not enough people. I think you should add more people. My final problem is that there isn’t that many areas to explore unless you’re really far into the game."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R496]",
      "area": "developer_record",
      "claim": "A parent praises ConcernedApe as one of the best game developers of all time, indicating positive developer reputation.",
      "stance": "neutral",
      "quote": "ConcernedApe is one of the best game developers of all time, and if you’re looking for a cozy game to get into I reccomend this one!"
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R450]",
      "area": "age_gating",
      "claim": "A parent reports that the game has no age gate issues, as it is widely enjoyed without reported inappropriate content for children.",
      "stance": "neutral",
      "quote": "This is one of the best games I've ever played. I own it on my phone, playstation, PC, and switch. It has given me comfort and joy through hard times and never gets old. I recommend this game to literally everyone."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R451]",
      "area": "money",
      "claim": "A parent reports that the game requires a one-time purchase of around six dollars and questions the lack of account sign-in for multiplayer access.",
      "stance": "neutral",
      "quote": "My one and ONLY issue is that you can’t sign in to accounts, so no multiplayer. Ofc I know about the developer work around but I would still like to access my farms from my Xbox account :3"
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R460]",
      "area": "contact",
      "claim": "A parent reports that multiplayer connection fails when trying to play with a friend, preventing co-op play.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "I CANT PLAY WITH MY GIRLFRIEND FIX IT!!!!"
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R472]",
      "area": "bug",
      "claim": "A parent reports being unable to progress past the new game screen after purchasing the game, preventing gameplay.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "I just purchased the game. Tried to create a new character and the game will not let me past that screen to start a new game. I was really looking forward to playing this."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R473]",
      "area": "contact",
      "claim": "A parent reports that multiplayer always says connection failed, preventing co-op play.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "Fix Multiplayer I can’t play multiplayer since it always says connection failed."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R492]",
      "area": "bug",
      "claim": "A parent reports the screen blacks out unexpectedly, forcing them to let the day run and costing in-game money to revive, which happens too often.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "Love the game, but why exactly does the screen blackout and my only option is to let the rest of the day run so I don’t lose any of my progress which ends up costing me “money” to be revived. It happens far too often please fix the dang bug!"
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R494]",
      "area": "bug",
      "claim": "A parent reports that coop mode has been broken for months, causing crashes and freezes on the connection screen.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "They never fix bugs, I haven’t been able to use the coop mode for months now fix it please it just crashes and freezes on the connecting screen"
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R467]",
      "area": "bug",
      "claim": "A parent reports that chicken heart gains and name changes are not registering, indicating a bug in interaction systems.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "Dont get me wrong i love the game i do its just tht there is to many lags and one of those lags are the hearts for marnie is not going through and the chickens when i feed the and gain likes from them is not coming throw like At ALL and when i am trying to change the animals names i cant, it will let me change there names but it wont go throw 😩 fix this"
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R485]",
      "area": "bug",
      "claim": "A parent reports that newer phones do not fully cover the hotbar, leaving UI elements obscured.",
      "stance": "mitigation",
      "quote": "Great game, but on newer phones the not h completely covers the hotbar. Hope it gets fixed soon."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R488]",
      "area": "content",
      "claim": "A parent describes the game as relaxing and fun to play with friends, highlighting positive social content.",
      "stance": "neutral",
      "quote": "It is so relaxing, its fun to play with friends and have fun"
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R498]",
      "area": "neutral",
      "claim": "A parent suggests adding a community center icon that jiggles when hovering over uncompleted donations, a minor UI enhancement.",
      "stance": "neutral",
      "quote": "We need a community center icon that jiggles when hovering over items that have yet to be donated. Other than that this game is incredible for being mobile."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R499]",
      "area": "contact",
      "claim": "A parent reports that controller support is inadequate, as many touch buttons are unmappable and selling items in the bin is impossible.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "The controller support just isn’t up to par. Many touch buttons aren’t mappable on controller and it’s not possible to sell items in the bin with controller. Other essential controls are just not possible on controller."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R500]",
      "area": "bug",
      "claim": "A parent reports that the iPhone version is unplayable due to rounded screen corners preventing button presses in the corners.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "Unable to even start the game given the rounded screen. Unable to click buttons on the corners. Not well adapted for iphones. Dont waste your money"
    }
  ]
}
